archetypes.name: security-prompt-routing
archetypes.rationale: The change restores security-adjacent public-filing guidance in implementer prompts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the restored caution closes the uncertain-security public filing path without adding broader behavior. Verify the wording appears in the source prompt and both generated prompts. Confirm SECURITY.md does not need an update unless the wording changes behavior rather than restoring it. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
